limits: Only invented API responses were exercised; no actual human review or Forgejo API compatibility is established by these nine tests.
A zero-review PR or incompatible/pending record may refuse projection; no approval or status may be invented to make it pass.
This receipt adds no authority beyond the previously reviewed unsigned binding.
mandatory_next_checks: Use only a fixed authenticated origin/transport with total byte, request, time and output budgets; no candidate callback or URL.
Qualify actual Forgejo17 JSON/headers, pagination and permissions with the distinct read-only observer identity.
Read and bind branch protections and actor identities through their own fixed contracts.
Re-read the selected review immediately before merge; stable page counts and unchanged head do not prevent a review edit, dismissal or replacement during pagination.
Match every consumed manifest artifact/source to the signed attestation, then apply the separately qualified merge/signature/anti-replay authority.
reviewed_properties: API routes are constructed only from fixed namespace, adopted repository enum, integer PR number and validated lowercase commit hash; returned URLs never select a request.
Repository identity/private/default-main, same-repository base/head, fixed Forgejo17 version, main commit, commit/tree and previous generation are checked.
Every review page has a stable numeric X-Total-Count, bounded page size and count, no duplicate ids and no short incomplete page; missing/changed count refuses.
Outstanding human or team requests and team review records refuse; projected fields pass the existing closed review contract.
PR state/head/base/reviewer requests and current main are reread after pagination.
Review bodies stay in an internal projection; this module has no CLI, export, HTTP transport or mutation.
scope: independent local API projection source review; no HTTP, credentials or production data
